text:
Lina (Marketing): Quick kickoff: we want a compact launch for the new OSS refapp focused on developer onboarding and measurable inbound. idea: a 3-week drip of 5 micro-tutorials + a mid-week live bench showcase that publishes a public leaderboard and a lightweight lead capture flow. thoughts? :seedling:

Ravi (DevRel): Sounds good. i'll scope tutorials to: quick install, basic generate, embeddings, perf tuning, and deploy to prod. keep each one 10-20 mins. goal: runnable in 15 minutes with 1-2 commands.

Sofia (Product): Messaging should lean into "predictable inference" and "unit economics." for the bench show, we should highlight concrete numbers (tokens/sec, median p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens) and compare quantization profiles. can we get those numbers reproducibly?

Alex (Eng): yes. plan: provide a docker image and a tiny harness script. single-command bench: `docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_KEY=$REDWOOD_KEY redwood/refapp-bench:latest --model redwood-13b --seq 256 --iters 40`. script emits results.json with {"throughput":..., "p95":..., "config":...}. leaderboard will read these JSONs.

Marta (Docs): i'll create a uniform repo layout and tutorial template: /tutorials/01-install, /tutorials/02-generate, /tutorials/03-embeddings, /tutorials/04-optimize, /tutorials/05-deploy, plus /bench. each tutorial will have: TL;DR, run commands, expected output, troubleshooting. will open PR today.

Sam (Growth): inbound plan: small form at end of each tutorial (email, company, interest checkbox: tutorials/bench/enterprise). map to HubSpot with source=oss-refapp, utm params captured. also want to add a hidden field for "use_case" for quick segmentation. set up thank-you redirect to sandbox.

Ravi (DevRel): tutorials will include short snippets. example quickstart:```bash
# clone and run dev refapp
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp-sample.git
cd refapp-sample
docker build -t refapp:local .
docker run -e REDWOOD_KEY=$REDWOOD_KEY -p 8080:8080 refapp:local
# curl test
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

Alex (Eng): i'll add bench runner: `python bench/run_bench.py --model redwood-13b --seq 512 --iters 50 --out results.json`. will also export a summary CSV for leaderboard ingestion.

Marta (Docs): draft repo branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp-sample/tree/marketing-launch-wip (WIP). using README template and tutorial skeleton.

Sam (Growth): webinar week: 45-minute session: 20m demo (tutorial highlights), 15m bench/analysis (Alex), 10m Q&A. CTAs: try sandbox, request enterprise trial. set up short survey on follow-up to capture intent.

Sofia (Product): Product will supply two slides: architecture overview and cost/latency tradeoff graph. Alex to provide CSV by EOD Wed so I can generate the plot.

Alex (Eng): baseline bench data available Wed EOD. i'll attach results JSON + CSV and a quick matplotlib PNG.

Ravi (DevRel): proposed timeline: week 0 (this week): repo + docs + bench harness; week 1: publish tutorials 1-2; week 2: webcast + bench + leaderboard; week 3: publish tutorials 3-5 + follow-ups and amplify social.

Lina (Marketing): nice. immediate action items: 1) Marta - publish tutorial template PR today; 2) Alex - bench CSV + plot by Wed EOD; 3) Sam - HubSpot mapping and sandbox redirect by Fri; 4) Ravi - two tutorial drafts by next Tue. i'll draft external launch post (blog + tweet thread) after we have first tutorial + bench numbers.

Marta (Docs): will open PR and tag reviewers; also add a short troubleshooting section for common docker/network errors.

inbound-bot: form-submission received: user "chris@example.com" interest=bench (auto-tagged). routing to growth queue.

Sam (Growth): inbound test confirmed. mapping doc will include list ids and expected workflows.

Lina (Marketing): weekly check-in Thu 9am PT. drop blockers here before then. thanks team :rocket:
file_comment: launch execution thread for OSS refapp micro-tutorials + public bench
